content: Ebinwa bya Samweli by’okuleka Saulu omu bucîranuzi
Samweli anacibwîra bene Israheli, erhi: «Ka murhabwîni oku nakagiyumvîrhiza akanwa kinyu, muli ebi mwanampûnaga byoshi, kwarhuma nyimika omwâmi winyu.
Lêro mubonage, oku ye mwâmi okola wakamurhegeka oyo. Bulya ncikolera mushosi, muntu wa mvi, na bagala bâni abâla ekarhî kinyu. Niono namushokolîre kurhenga eburhò bwâni kuhika gano mango.

Mumbwîne niono ndi hanôla, mumbwîre embere za Nnâmahanga n’embere z’oyu mwambali wâge, nkâfu erhi ndogomi ya ndi nkola nyanzire. Indi nababazize nîsi erhi kumurhindibuza? Indi nkola mpûnyire empongano, mpu lyo muh’olubanja. Mweshi mwananyêrera.»
Boshi banacishuza, mpu: «Orharhujiriraga bubî buci, orhanarhulibuzagya orhanahambiraga mpongano ya ndi».

Anashubibabwîra, erhi: «Nyamubâho yêne muhamiriza ekarhî kîrhu rhweshi, n’oyôla mwambali ali muhamiriza wâni olu lusiku lw’ene, oku ntà kantu kabî mwavumbwîre omu bwôrhere bwâni.» Olubaga lwanacishuza mpu: «Nêci ali muhamîrizi.»
Samweli anacibwîra olubaga erhi: «Nyamubâho wayimânikaga Mûsa na Aroni anakûla olubaga lwinyu e Mîsiri, ali muhamîrizi wâni.
Mushegerage hanôla, bunôla nkolaga namuyêreka aminjà Nyamubâho amujirire mwe n’ababusi binyu.
Nêci erhi Yakôbo abà akola ali e Mîsiri, Abanya-Mîsiri barhindubuza ababusi binyu, nabo bayimbirira Nyamubâho abarhumira Mûsa na Aroni mpu babarhenze eyo, abatulire hano hantu.
Ci kwônene bayibagira Lungwè wâbo, naye abahâna emwa Sisera murhambo w’engabo ya Hasori: Kandi ashubibahâna emwa Abafilistini n’emwa mwâmi w’e Mowabu, abôla boshi babalibuza n’entambala nyinji.

Go mango bayakûzize Nyamubâho, mpu: Rhwakuhemukîre Yâgirwa Nyakasane rhwakuleka, lêro rhwagendikolera abandi banyamuzinda, bo ba Bali, ba Astarte: mpu ci bunôla orhulîkûzagye oku bashombanyi bîrhu, lêro rhukolaga rhuhizire okukukolera.»
Lungwè abarhumira Yerubali, abarhumira Bedani, abarhumira Yefutè, na Samweli, abalikuza oku bashombanyi, bali bazongolosire, n’enyuma ly’aho mwabona omurhûla.

Kandi amango mwabonaga Nahashi, mwâmi muguma wa bene Amoniti, mweshi erhi mubona oku adwîrhe amurhega, mwene mwambwîra mpu lêro ninyu mubè n’omwâmi wakamurhegeka n’obwôla Nyamubâho yênene ye Mwâmi winyu.
Alagi bunôla omwâmi mwacîshogaga, ye mwâmi mwashengaga; sinzagyi oku Nyamubâho amamushobôza omwâmi wakamurhegeka.

Mukarhînya Nyamubâho, munamukolere, mukanayumwa izù lyâge, n’akabà murhacicîhindwiri oku kanwa ka Nyamubâho, na kandi mwoyo, haguma n’oyo mwâmi winyu, erhi mwakashimba Nyamubâho, Nyamuzinda winyu, kuli kwinjà.
Ci kwônene erhi mwakabula kushimba izù lya Nyamubâho, okuboko kwâge kwanamugombya nka kula kwagombagya ababusi binyu.
Murhangibera ahâla buno, lyo mubona ecirhangâzo Lungwè ajira omu masù ginyu.
Ka garhali mango ga kurhema engano gano? Nkola nashenga Nyamubâho, amurhumire emilazô n’enkuba mwabonerako bubî bunene bunganaci mwajizire embere za Nyamubâho erhi muhambira okubà n’omwâmi.
Samweli ashenga Nyamubâho, na Nyamubâho alîka olwôla lusiku emilazô n’enkuba, ntyo olubaga lwayôboha bwenêne Nyamubâho na Samweli.
Oluhaga lwoshi lwanacibwîra Samweli mpu: «Oshengere abarhumisi bâwe oyûla Nyamubâho, Nyamuzinda wâwe, rhurhafâga, bulya oku mabî gîrhu rhwayûshwîrekwo okuhûna omwâmi».
Samweli ashuza olubaga erhi: «Murhayôbohaga, mwajizire agôla mabî goshi, ci mumanye murhacîhinduliraga Nyamubâho, ci mukolere Nyamubâho n’omurhima gwinyu goshi.
“Mumanye mwakashubiderha mpu mukola mwagendikulikira eby’obukurungu n’obwo birhankanamuciza ciru, bulya bya busha”.
“Bulya arhankalekêrera oluhaga lwâge erhi izîno lyâge lirhuma, bulya Nyamubâho yênene ahîzire okumujira lubaga lwâge
“Kuli nie ntà mango nankagomera Nyamubâho, omu kuleka okukamushengera. Ci namubwîriza enjira nyinjà na nongêdu”.
“Casiga murhînye Nyakasane munamukolere n’omurhima gwinyu goshi. Mwene mwanahashibona minjà maci amâjira ekarhî kinyu”.
“Ci kwônene, erhi mwankashubikajira amabî, abè mwe, abè oyo mwâmi winyu, mwanahungumuka”».
